mechanics.claim: Disintegrate is a projectile that deals damage when it hits, not instantly on cast.
mechanics.quote: hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: If the target dies from Disintegrate (or is already dead when the missile arrives), the ability's cooldown is halved and its mana cost is refunded, which affects follow-up casts in a sustained fight.
mechanics.quote: ''Disintegrate'' will also grant the cooldown reduction and mana cost refund if the target is dead upon the missile's arrival.
